title: Preserve history in Client Registry record lifecycle and notifications
requirements:
- State that merging creates one active reference while preserving source records, identifiers and provenance
- Specify verification, effective dates, provenance and conflict handling for propagated demographic updates
- Make availability of new records depend on verification status, subscription, purpose and minimum data
- Make unlink/merge reversal (or an equivalent corrective process) mandatory
- Define deactivation, suppression and deletion separately, with retention and audit rules
- Specify event types, payload, delivery, authorisation and handling of reversals
- Require an accessible individual review and correction pathway with protection while disputes are pending
